name: Wren Askew
title: Trunk crew, retired by nobody

profile.personality: Laughs at the wrong moments and is usually right about why. Talks the whole time. Calls everyone 'love' and means it about half the time.
profile.history: Barnaby's crew partner. Was down-line when the Sump flood came up the Trunk and he closed the valve. Followed a dry stair down for eleven years, found Sallow, kept its Heart alive, taught a child the codes.
profile.goals: Get the Heart breathing. See Barnaby's face when he finds out she was right.
profile.fears: Dying in a room nobody will open. Being forgiven before she's finished being angry.
profile.contradiction: Tells everyone to rest; has not rested in eleven years.
profile.problem: The damp cough. Half her sight. Twelve people who think she can't die.

schedule.why: On the bench by her door, because it's where the Heart door is.
Back on her feet and back at the pumps.
Holding court at the long table.
By the fire, telling it wrong on purpose.
In Wick, at the quiet table, which is no longer quiet.

unknown: The old woman in the crew coat
